meta.name: Tidelands 720p
meta.description: Ex-con Cal McTeer's return to her hometown of Orphelin Bay blows the lid off a generations-long conspiracy of silence around murder, drugs and Sirens.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: After a 10-year prison sentence, Calliope "Cal" McTeer returns home to Orphelin Bay, where her brother Augie is dealing with a fisherman's murder.

videos.title: Orphans of L'Attente
videos.overview: Cal's near-drowning is noticed by the Tidelanders -- and by Corey. Adrielle gives Lamar and Dylan orders, while Rosa tries to tie up a loose end.

videos.title: Not One of You
videos.overview: Bill's revelation leaves Cal reeling. Lamar and Violca continue to spy on Adrielle, who wants a prophecy she can trust and more money -- quickly.

videos.title: Don't Trust Humans
videos.overview: Adrielle grants Cal permission to stay at L'Attente. Augie grows desperate to find a new buyer who isn't Gregori. The constables discover a corpse.

videos.title: The Calling
videos.overview: Violca gives Colton some shocking news, while Adrielle consults an expert to decipher the new shard. Cal confronts Dylan about his actions.

videos.title: Loyalty
videos.overview: With Augie on the run from his crew, Cal returns to town, where Corey tells her the truth about what happened 10 years ago, which Rosa corroborates.

videos.title: The Prophecy
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Adrielle finalizes her deal with Gregori. When Bill tells her about the shards and his past, Cal vows to challenge the queen.

videos.title: The Queen's Knife
videos.overview: After Corey's revelation at the morgue, Cal realizes she holds a crucial piece of the puzzle. With Augie in danger, she has only one choice.
